_provenance.blind: Judged from the 34 live source pages (captures, rendered DOM, S3 trees, S6 contact sheets) and the design-system v3 docs of the source repo. No migration file was read: blocks/, styles/, scripts/, head.html, stardust/first-page/, stardust/replica/ stayed closed. Seeded from the owner's starting hypothesis; names and verdicts below are the spec's.
_provenance.verdictTarget: Pixel parity with the live site (replica flow). Structural reuse of an aem-boilerplate or Block Collection block is recorded as variant when parity needs a variant class and CSS; reuse only where the reference block renders the source as-is.
_provenance.referenceBlocks: aem-boilerplate (hero, cards, columns, header, footer, fragment) + AEM Block Collection (video, embed, table, tabs, carousel, accordion, quote, ...)
_provenance.styleWords: Section bands map to section-metadata style words: band--plain -> plain, band--alt -> alt, band--tint -> tint (+ an accent word such as aem-ai, aem, agents, work, cyan, amber, leaf, bronze, mint, rose for the band accent), and inverse for the canon's inverse band (not on any of the 34 pages).

header.description: Sticky site header: text wordmark Jack Jin, four nav links (Technical Writing, Portfolio, Talks, Certifications), Light/Dark/System theme control; folds behind a Menu toggle below 1024px.
header.rationale: 34/34 pages, one fingerprint. Boilerplate header loads /nav as a fragment; parity needs the three-zone layout, the 44px targets, the current-page rule and the theme control, so it is the boilerplate header with site CSS and a tools section.

footer.description: Compact one-row footer: copyright with city and four profile links.
footer.rationale: 34/34 pages, one fingerprint. Boilerplate footer fragment as-is structurally; the single compact row is CSS.

section-style.description: Full-bleed section band: the section-metadata Style word sets the ground (plain, alt, tint, inverse) and an optional accent word keys the tint.
section-style.rationale: EDS section metadata is built in; the band classes become section classes. 16 bands on the 5 non-article pages. Articles and the portfolio do not use bands.

band--alt.rationale: Style: alt (Paper Alt ground), the closing note bands. 3 bands.

band--tint.rationale: Style: tint (+ accent word), the home Selected work band. 1 band.

section-style.reconcile: RECONCILE 2026-10-25: section-metadata style words plain (default), alt, tint, inverse; related closes an article column. Keys id and note-label are data, not styles.

hero.description: Page opening: breadcrumb where present, the serif title, then the page's lede. The home, writing, talks and certifications heroes carry the ambient canvas (page-art.js) behind the copy.
hero.rationale: One block on all 34 pages with five content shapes. None of the source heroes has a background picture, so the boilerplate hero renders none of them as-is; each variant is the boilerplate hero cell model (heading, text, buttons) plus a variant class and CSS. The canvas is decoration added by code, never authored.

home.rationale: Display title, three-line positioning with an italic last line, summary, one primary button and a text link; the champion proof list sits beside it (proof-list).

hub.rationale: Writing, talks, certifications: breadcrumb, display title, one-line summary over the ambient canvas.

article.rationale: 28 articles: breadcrumb, title, mono byline (author, date, updated, read time, video length), summary; three articles add a series nav (Part 1/2/3). Byline values come from page metadata.

page.rationale: Privacy: breadcrumb and display title only.

portfolio.rationale: Portfolio: kicker, title, deck, primary button, featured links over its own signal-field and glow (portfolio/script.js).

hero.reconcile: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): built: home, writing, talks, certifications, page (listings stream); portfolio is the portfolio template head.

proof-list.description: Hero aside of dated facts: the Adobe Champion badge image, three rows (link + dated note), a View all link.
proof-list.rationale: Home only. It is the canon proof list (label + dated value rows) with a badge image on top; no reference block lays out a ruled definition list.

champion.rationale: The badge image variant on the home hero.

proof-list.reconcile: RECONCILE 2026-10-25: delivered as the hero (home) block's second cell (blocks/hero), as v3's "hero with proof list" is one component; the content model (label, linked badge image, list of link + dated note, closing link) is this entry's. A standalone proof-list block is built only if another page needs one.

breadcrumb.description: Home / Section / Page trail in mono 12px; separators drawn by CSS.
breadcrumb.rationale: On 32/34 pages (inside the hero on articles, in the hub band elsewhere). Derived from the path and page title, so code builds it; authors never type it.
breadcrumb.reconcile: RECONCILE 2026-10-25: authored as an ordered list in the article head section, wrapped as nav.breadcrumb by templates/article (EW5: a list is one editable unit).

showcase.description: Text column beside a media column (frame, panel, deck, timeline); flip puts media first from 768px, wide stacks centered text over full-width media.
showcase.rationale: Two cells, text and media, is the columns model; parity needs the showcase CSS (serif title with an italic accent phrase, mono meta, lead) and the band-accent rule. On the portfolio a story often holds a block of its own (frame, diagram deck, carousel, ladder, stat chips, flow); EDS blocks do not nest, so those stay their own rows next to the showcase (nested_in in page-blocks).

feature.rationale: Home Selected work: Anima Mesh text beside a diagram frame.

talk.rationale: adaptTo() 2026 recap: 25 talks, each a slide image beside notes.

with-nested-blocks.rationale: Portfolio story whose media is another block.

flip.rationale: class story flip on 5 portfolio stories (rendered DOM); the parser does not split it, so it has no count in blocks.json.

wide.rationale: class story wide on 14 portfolio stories (rendered DOM); not split by the parser.

story.rationale: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): A portfolio story that holds its own blocks.

showcase.reconcile: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): built: feature, story, flip, wide, tall (portfolio stream).

row-list.description: Hairline-ruled rows: a mono kind or date column, a linked title, a short note; the talks variant adds an event line and links.
row-list.rationale: Related list closing all 28 articles, the 9-row talk history and the home work links. No reference block draws ruled definition-style rows.

related.rationale: 28 articles: kind (Article, Talk, Video) + title + note.

talks.rationale: Talks page: date column, title, event and place, links to recordings and write-ups.

links.rationale: Home: four linked work rows with a one-line note each.

author-box.description: Closing author card: initials avatar, name, role line, three profile links.
author-box.rationale: 28/28 articles with identical copy; a candidate for a shared fragment so one edit updates every article.
author-box.reconcile: RECONCILE 2026-10-25: built in D1 (blocks/author-box); pattern and vocabulary in stardust/explainer-family.md.

rail.description: Sticky right rail on articles: On this page, a progress bar, numbered part links (some with 72x46 thumbnails), and links to the video and source.
rail.rationale: 28/28 articles. The part titles are shorter than the H2s and the thumbnails are chosen per part, so the rows are authored; the progress bar and the current-part state are code.
rail.reconcile: RECONCILE 2026-10-25: built in D1 (blocks/rail); pattern and vocabulary in stardust/explainer-family.md.

figure.description: Framed figure: an image (hand-drawn board, slide or diagram) with a caption; shot is a narrower screenshot with a soft drop shadow.
figure.rationale: 92 figures on 25 articles. Default-content images would lose the frame, caption rule and zoom; neither reference library has a captioned figure.

board.rationale: 83 instances: boards, slides and diagrams at xwide or wide width.

shot.rationale: 9 instances on 3 articles: product screenshots, some shot--narrow.

page.rationale: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): A photographed notebook page, at most 420px.

narrow.rationale: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): shot: 560px portrait; board: a 520px centered photo.

tall.rationale: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): A tall image at its own size, at most 560px (2025-10-12).

native.rationale: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): The image at its own size, never upscaled.

open.rationale: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): board opens full size on click.

figure.reconcile: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): built: board (default), shot, page, narrow, slim, compact, tall, native, open; a YouTube link makes it a video; image paragraphs before the caption are the media (a split board). One-article words are register R8, R10, R12.

video.description: YouTube nocookie embed in a 16:9 frame with a caption linking to YouTube.
video.rationale: 20 embeds on 19 pages. The Block Collection video/embed block covers YouTube; parity needs the caption figure and the nocookie host.
video.reconcile: RECONCILE 2026-10-25: delivered by figure: a YouTube link paragraph in a figure block plays in place (caption below); a lone YouTube link in default content is auto-blocked into a figure (scripts.js buildVideoAutoBlocks). No separate video block.

code.description: Dark code block (Night 850 ground, 14px radius) with line numbers, token colors and an optional caption; static, wrap and prose variants by class.
code.rationale: 45 blocks on 18 articles. Tokens are pre-highlighted spans (tk-k, tk-s, tk-n, tk-c) in the source; the migration needs either authored code with client highlighting or the spans carried as HTML, an implementer decision.
code.reconcile: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): built: wrap, prose, plain, stack (register R9, R12).

wrap.rationale: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): The bar label wraps, the source link stays on one line.

prose.rationale: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): Lines wrap under their text with a hanging indent.

plain.rationale: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): No syntax colors (a prompt in a source file).

stack.rationale: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): On phones the bar stacks label over link.

lab.description: Interactive explainer frame: a mono bar (what it models + a source link) over a two-column grid of controls and readout.
lab.rationale: 30 labs on 13 articles. The frame is shared; what runs inside is per article (state machines, token labs, gates), which is the explainer question.
lab.reconcile: RECONCILE 2026-10-25: built in D1 (blocks/lab); pattern and vocabulary in stardust/explainer-family.md.

token.rationale: RECONCILE 2026-10-25: the token lab engine (Web Crypto RS256, the four checks of google-token.js).

compare.rationale: 5 articles. Tabs from the Block Collection give the tablist; the panes and the stage are site CSS.

narrow.rationale: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): Portrait screenshots at most 560px, each opens full size.

touch.rationale: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): Tabs at least 44px on phones.

data-table.description: Captioned data table in a scrolling wrap: mono uppercase headers over a strong rule, first column in Ink.
data-table.rationale: 14 tables on 9 articles. Block Collection table builds the table from rows; parity needs the caption, the 36rem minimum and the scroll wrap.

scroll.rationale: 2 wide tables in a horizontal scroller.

nowrap.rationale: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): Last column on one line.

caption.rationale: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): Last row is the caption, under the table.

sr-caption.rationale: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): Last row is the caption, screen readers only.

row-heads.rationale: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): First cell of each row is a row header.

data-table.reconcile: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): built: nowrap, cheat, rank, stack, caption, sr-caption, row-heads; a short row spans its last cell (register R12).

chips.description: Row of mono chips with a dot.
chips.rationale: 2 standalone instances; most chips live inside labs and explainers.

explainer.description: Bespoke interactive article explainers: request flows, cache labs, walkthrough steps, tabbed tables, DOM terminals, comparison stages, verdict callouts. Each renders complete without JavaScript and is driven by an article script.
explainer.rationale: 32 root instances on 21 articles plus the labs; 26 articles ship a local explainer.css and most a script. One block name with one variant per explainer keeps the catalog honest; whether each variant is a block with authored rows or a code-only widget is open question explainer-build.

interactive.rationale: Two-letter explainers the parser cannot name (vs, ru, pv, pq, mx, mg, hv, ff, bp, pl): cache lab, request flow, walkthrough steps, tabbed table, DOM terminal.

request-flow.rationale: Portfolio CIAM flow (three nodes); the walkthrough and request-flow explainers in articles share the shape.

details.rationale: A details disclosure inside an explainer (azure-rbac article); not a FAQ.

explainer.reconcile: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): built as one core block with 40 engines, one word each: beat-sim, branch-push, capability-pivot, consideration-lens, content-contract, credential-chain, defect-lab, empty-cohort, era-steps, freezeframe, harvest-sorter, header-relay, hook-guard, hook-switchboard, line-map, model-merge, offering-path, option-matrix, option-pair, parser-lab, persisted-query, request-pipe, retry-ladder, reuse-stacks, role-assignments, score-blend, scripted-flow, skill-tracker, spec-filter, stale-timeline, stardust-lifecycle, stardust-versions, step-checklist, task-loop, task-protocol, theme-swap, tool-dialects, tool-loop, trail, work-patterns. Each engine has an import engine in stardust/scripts/import-engines/.

jump-links.description: Portfolio in-page jump links to the project chapters.

timeline.description: Time-based structures: the portfolio Gantt of projects over time, the release ladder (versions on a rail) and the career milestones.
timeline.rationale: Portfolio (3) plus ladders inside two article labs. The canon timeline (release ladder) is one variant; the Gantt is drawn from data rows.

gantt.rationale: Projects over time: rows of bars on a year scale with a now marker and a method legend.

ladder.rationale: Continuous Executive Agent release history: eras and rungs.

divider.description: Labeled divider between portfolio chapters (mono label between hairlines); the year variant is the large outlined year numeral.
divider.rationale: 11 on the portfolio. A plain hr loses the label; section metadata could carry it, but the label is content, so a small block.

chapter-head.description: Project chapter opening: outlined numeral, title with italic subtitle, mono meta and method line, thesis, optional arc and facts.
chapter-head.rationale: 11 chapters on the portfolio; the Anima Mesh chapter carries class flagship (larger title), two chapters class lofi. Variants flagship and lofi are classes on the chapter, not split by the parser.

frame.description: Bordered figure for a diagram or screenshot with a mono caption; diagram variant links the full-size file; portrait caps at 340px.
frame.rationale: Home work feature and portfolio stories (frame--diagram, diagram-frame, portrait in the DOM). Kept apart from figure because the portfolio frame has the diagram-ground and link-to-full-size rules.
frame.reconcile: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): built: diagram, sub, portrait (portfolio stream).

tabs.description: Diagram deck: a toolbar, tab buttons and six diagram panes.
tabs.rationale: Portfolio Anima Mesh, one instance with six panes.

diagram-deck.rationale: Toolbar label and position counter above the tabs.

panel.description: Chapter-closing panel (edge): a heading and a grid of short approaches or a roadmap note.
panel.rationale: 2 on the portfolio. The canon's panel--inverse appears on none of the 34 pages.

edge.rationale: Edge grid with a closing line.

panel.reconcile: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): built: edge, pulse, glossary, compare, wire, flow, bakeoff (portfolio stream).

stat-chips.description: Wrapping row of evidence chips, the value bold in the band accent.
stat-chips.rationale: 2 on the portfolio, nested in stories.

stats.description: Counter row of block stat values (lifetime figures).
stats.rationale: 1 on the portfolio; values are in the HTML, a script may count them up.

carousel.description: Three-slide image carousel with controls and a count.
carousel.rationale: Shadow Pivot chapter, one instance (slides load lazily).

cards.description: Grid of compact tool cards, each card itself a link to a repo.
cards.rationale: Portfolio Smaller repos: 7 tool cards. Boilerplate cards plus the tool variant (the card is the link, repo mark, mono title).

tool.rationale: The one card whose element is the link.

list.rationale: RECONCILE 2026-10-25: the home's four selected-work links (a 4-up grid of linked items under a strong rule), built as cards (list); moved here from row-list (links): the look is a card grid, each card one link.

repo.rationale: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): Repo cards with a stretched link.

cards.reconcile: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): built: list, tool, project, repo (portfolio stream).

writing-filter.description: Writing index filter bar: topic and year filter pills with counts and a search field (GET ?q=).
writing-filter.rationale: Configuration only, everything else comes from the index and user input: a widget.

writing-list.description: Writing index rows: cover, date, title, summary, tags, facts; 28 rows today.
writing-list.rationale: Authored by hand on the source; on EDS it renders from the query index so a new article lists itself.

facts.description: Article facts paragraph (first published, rewritten, skill or repo version) in the label voice.
facts.rationale: On 28 articles as p.article-facts. The parser reads a paragraph as default content, so page-blocks never places it and blocks.json shows 0; reach is the facts signal in implementation.json. Authors cannot class a paragraph in EDS, so parity needs a block (or an auto-block rule).
facts.reconcile: RECONCILE 2026-10-25: built as block fine-print (blocks/fine-print), so the name facts stays free for v3's facts table (C2).

chapters.description: Watch this part: timestamp links into the article video, one row per part.
chapters.rationale: p.watch paragraphs on 17 articles (signal watch). Same parser limit as facts: 0 in blocks.json, measured by signal.
chapters.reconcile: RECONCILE 2026-10-25: the article's "Watch this part" rows are default content (a paragraph starting "Watch this part" with video links), decorated by templates/article; chapters stays for v3's chapters list (C3).

proof-links.description: Row of typed links (repo, post, video, live) with masked line icons.
proof-links.rationale: 3 rows inside portfolio story text; the parser keeps them in the showcase text cell. Typed by destination per the canon.

switch.description: Two or more modes of one explainer behind a radio switch (the explainer kit's two-way switch: the bar placement bp, production vs laptop pvl). Mode rows: label | columns; a single-cell row before the modes names it, after them is the caption. Code marks (mark, add, note) color runs of a mode's code.
switch.rationale: RECONCILE 2026-10-25: added. Built in D1 for the article archetype (bp); the explainer interactive variant listed bp among the two-letter explainers. pvl maps here in D2.

series.description: The parts of a multi-part series at the end of the article head: label, accessible name, one link per part, the current part marked.
series.reconcile: RECONCILE 2026-10-25 (rollout): built (main thread, for A1 and A2).

talk-list.description: The adaptTo() recap: one row per talk with anchor, head, slide and notes.
talk-list.rationale: One article (2026-10-10), in place of the catalog showcase (talk).

credentials.description: Certifications page credential groups with issuer verification links.

fine-print.description: The article facts line (small faint print).

columns.description: Boilerplate columns, used by the home two-column band.
